lesson.uz:
Butun buyumlar soni uchun Integer, o‘rtacha va o‘lchovlar uchun Real ishlating. / kasrli bo‘lish, div butun bo‘linma, mod qoldiqni beradi. 17 div 5 = 3; 17 mod 5 = 2.
To‘liq qutilar va ortgan buyumlarni ajratishda div va mod juft ishlatiladi. Nolga bo‘lmang. Kasr natijani Integer o‘zgaruvchiga saqlamang. Hisob natijasini 6 ta kasr raqamidan ortiq aniqlikda qoldirish mumkin.
lesson.en:
Use Integer for whole items and Real for averages and measurements. / produces real division, div the integer quotient, and mod the remainder. 17 div 5 = 3; 17 mod 5 = 2.
Use div and mod together for full boxes and leftovers. Never divide by zero. Do not store a fractional result in an Integer. You may retain more than six decimal digits.
